title: How Many Korean Households Have Just One Person?
context: Living alone is an increasingly visible part of life in Korea.
question: In 2024, roughly what share of South Korea's general households consisted of just one person?
feedback_a: This is much lower than the reported share of one-person general households.
feedback_c: The reported share was approximately 36.1% in 2024, subject to verification against the original official table.
feedback_d: This is higher than the reported share.
insight: This measures households, not the share of all people living alone.
